title: Question on the page "menu"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[menu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html

Hi-  Would it be possible for us to have two sets of filters for our search results? That is, use two menus at the same time on different facets?

comments.body: And to clarify... This is what we're using:  https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/connectors/connectMenu.html

Not sure to perfectly understand your issue. You can have as many menus as you want on a different facets. Here is an example: ```jsx
```

Samuel answered for React InstantSearch, but for IsntantSearch.js the same counts:

```js
search.addWidget(customMenu(...));
search.addWidget(customMenu(...))
```
